# Supabase browser client

`supabase-2.119.0.js` is the unmodified UMD browser bundle from the official
`@supabase/supabase-js` npm package version 2.119.0 (`dist/umd/supabase.js`).
Its MIT license is included as `SUPABASE-LICENSE`.

SHA-256: `a867edbcfb029370aeec7223dd6180b560b621fbe3bc64c6584fb0369d1b7bce`.

The pinned bundle is served by MedSafe itself. App users do not need npm.
Source: https://github.com/supabase/supabase-js
